Name: Rin's portrait mod
Author: rinmenge
Description:
Inspired to make my own portraits by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7529]Eskbl's Wizard Portrait Mod[/url] and Pug.png's Harvey Portrait.
Mod will be updated with groups of characters as they are completed. Thank you for your patience and support!

How to Install:
[list]
[*]Unzip and move 'Rin's Portraits' folder into 'Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits'
( It'll look like: 'Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Rin's Portraits' )[*]Press 'P' ingame while dialogue box is open to toggle portraits.
[/list]you can find updates and WIPs on [url=http://www.tumblr.com/rinmenge]my tumblr[/url]
